# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 14 Jul 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## New Launches & Private Residential

- **Dunearn House to launch from S$1.475M — first private condo in Bukit Timah Turf City transformation** - A consortium of Frasers Property, CSC Land Group, and Sekisui House held a public preview from 10 July, with sales bookings set for 25 July 2026. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/dunearn-house-set-to-launch-from-s1-475m-first-condo-in-turf-city/)

- **Dunearn House review: indicative pricing from S$2,799 psf with a S$1.1M jump between unit types** - A detailed walkthrough covers the unit mix, layouts, site plan, and pricing structure, noting a significant price gap between unit tiers. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/dunearn-house-condo-review/)

- **River Modern sold 93% of 455 units at median S$3,229 psf over its launch weekend** - The project was a standout performer in the private residential market through H1 2026, according to a full roundup of new condo launches this year. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/new-condo-launches-2026/)

- **Lentor Gardens Residences (499 units) enters Lentor Hills as latest private condo addition** - The Kingsford-developed project is expected to offer one of the more attractive entry prices within the Lentor Hills estate. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/lentor-gardens-residences-new-launch-within-the-wider-market-analysis/)

## HDB Resale & Public Housing

- **Tampines executive flat transacts at S$1.24M — a new high for the town** - The 31-year-old flat crossed the S$1.2M threshold, reflecting continued demand for spacious executive flats in Tampines despite ageing leases. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/31-year-old-tampines-executive-hdb-flat-sets-towns-new-high-at-s1-24-million/)

- **SkyOasis @ Dawson records its first official 5-room resale at S$1.39M** - The July 2026 transaction is the first to appear in HDB's public resale records for this unit type at the development; a previously reported S$1.73M deal from 2024 was never reflected in official data. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/skyoasis-dawson-first-5-room-resale-at-s1-39-million-july-2026/)

- **Gillman Barracks to be redeveloped into a new housing estate for both public and private homes** - HDB studies confirm 25 of 86 buildings and eight hectares of forest will be retained across the 40-hectare site. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/gillman-barracks-set-to-become-a-new-housing-estate/)

- **Two-thirds of Maju Forest to be cleared for future HDB housing** - HDB will clear 15 hectares while retaining 8 hectares, including a nature trail and freshwater stream connecting to Bukit Timah and Central Catchment nature reserves. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/two-thirds-of-maju-forest-will-be-cleared-for-future-hdb-housing/)

## Infrastructure & Commercial

- **Circle Line Stage 6 opened 12 July 2026, completing the loop between HarbourFront and Marina Bay** - The article examines rental demand implications near the newly opened CCL6 stations. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/why-renting-near-the-new-circle-line-stations-makes-sense-in-2026/)

- **Fully leased 14-unit strata office portfolio at High Street Centre listed at S$17.8M** - The portfolio is open to foreign buyers, and CBD office rents are reported to be expected to rise by up to 20%. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/high-street-centre-strata-office-portfolio-sale/)
